records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real bug in lines 141-143 of user_serializer.rb. The code `website_host.split('.')[1..-1].join('.') == discourse_host.split('.')[1..-1].join('.')` compares domains by dropping the first label and comparing the rest. This means 'www.example.co.uk' and 'forum.other.co.uk' would both become 'example.co.uk' and 'other.co.uk' respectively - wait, let me re-read. Actually the comparison is: if website_host is 'www.example.co.uk' it becomes 'example.co.uk', and if discourse_host is 'forum.other.co.uk' it becomes 'other.co.uk'. These wouldn't match.
